steps.name: reveal all
steps.expr: const ids=['btn-plane-reveal','btn-scaling-reveal','btn-ffn-reveal','btn-shift-reveal','btn-assemble-reveal','btn-cache-reveal','btn-serving-reveal','btn-queue-reveal','btn-xover-reveal','btn-rt-reveal','btn-moe-reveal','btn-lin-reveal','btn-bpb-reveal','btn-zs-reveal']; const out=[]; for (const id of ids) { const b=document.getElementById(id); if(!b){out.push(id+':MISSING');continue;} b.click(); out.push(id+':'+b.textContent); } return out.join(' ')

steps.name: states
steps.expr: const clicks=[['prenorm-btns','post'],['prenorm-btns','pre'],['gqa-btns','1'],['gqa-btns','3'],['gqa-btns','9'],['stack-btns','2017'],['stack-btns','2024'],['scatter-btns','moe'],['lin-btns','linear'],['lin-btns','softmax'],['fit-k','3'],['fit-k','6']]; for (const [g,m] of clicks) { const b=document.querySelector('#'+g+' [data-m="'+m+'"]'); if(!b) return 'MISSING '+g+' '+m; b.click(); } for (let i=0;i<6;i++) document.getElementById('regime-step').click(); for (let i=0;i<5;i++) document.getElementById('moe-next').click(); document.getElementById('norm-states').querySelector('[data-m=gain]').click(); return 'ok'

steps.name: svg text clipping
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const vb=s.viewBox.baseVal; if(!vb||!vb.width) return; s.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t=>{ if(t.getAttribute('transform')) return; let b; try{b=t.getBBox();}catch(e){return;} if(b.width===0) return; if(b.x<-1||b.y<-1||b.x+b.width>vb.width+1||b.y+b.height>vb.height+1) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+t.textContent.slice(0,30)+'" '+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+' '+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)+' in '+vb.width+'x'+vb.height); }); }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no clipped text'

steps.name: svg text overlaps
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const ts=Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('text')).filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')&&t.textContent.trim()); const bs=ts.map(t=>{try{return t.getBBox();}catch(e){return null;}}); for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){ const a=bs[i],b=bs[j]; if(!a||!b||!a.width||!b.width) continue; const ox=Math.min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-Math.max(a.x,b.x), oy=Math.min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-Math.max(a.y,b.y); if(ox>3&&oy>3) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+ts[i].textContent.slice(0,22)+'" x "'+ts[j].textContent.slice(0,22)+'"'); } }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no overlaps'
